page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred; decorative woodcut border at the top. No margin notes, no running head, no page number visible.; One block of text at the top right: a dedication in italic lines, then a centred inscription with the signature below. A library stamp at the left is not printed text and is left out.

main_text.head: Reverendis admodûm, Clarißimis, Doctißimisque Viris,

p.i: Venerabili Collegio Carolino Templorum item vigi-lantissimis Abbatissani & Petrini Pastoribus Affi-nibus Collegis, honoratissimis.

page.notes: The page continues beyond this part; the lower portion is cut off. Some lines are blurred by show-through from the reverse side; readings of names are as far as legible. The library stamp (Bibliothek Kantonal-Lehranstalten zu Zürich) is not transcribed. The first line of the dedication is set in italic with some letters partly blurred; "Abbatissani" and "Affi-nibus" are read as printed. The signature line uses small capitals.
